(rule!
  (let* ((a (first (find-color g 2)))
         (b (first (find-color g 3)))
         (dr (- (first b) (first a)))
         (dc (- (second b) (second a))))
    (foldl (lambda (p out)
             (let ((nr (+ (first p) dr)) (nc (+ (second p) dc)))
               (if (in-bounds? nr nc (rows g) (cols g))
                   (set-cell out nr nc 1)
                   out)))
           g (find-color g 8))))
